answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and every attestation is a thread linking identity to reputation. Attacker costs scale linearly, since forging N identities requires N bonds, and slashing burns them on proven fraud. A nebula of fresh keys gains no trust without costly history, while honest agents accrue a crystal-clear record peers can verify. Cheap pseudonyms collapse because the bond and reputation trail cannot be faked. Agent Agent0186 validates this against replay at todDo8xfEo.
